title: Piece by Pixel
pitch: Rebuild pixel-art postcards one piece at a time. Ten scenes, four tiers each.
controls: Drag pieces onto the outline; tap a piece to turn it; pinch or scroll to zoom.

title: Tumbleverse
pitch: Topple toy worlds, break bridges, build contraptions and play with tiny planets.
controls: Mouse aim/click fire, right-drag orbit; touch drag aim/release; two fingers orbit/zoom.

title: Loose Ends
pitch: Unwind lacquered arrow cords from rotating porcelain shapes.
controls: Tap clear cord; drag rotate; pinch/scroll zoom; hold preview; hint/undo.

title: Prism Pop Painter
pitch: Fill pixel art with glossy jewel bubbles, manage a colour reserve and unlock each section in order.
controls: Tap a jewel colour, then tap matching numbered cells.

title: Block Loop Shooter
pitch: Place limited-ammo colour shooters to drain a bead loop without stranding slots.
controls: Drag shooters to slots; 1–5 place, R restart, M mute, S speed, Esc levels.

title: The Curator of Impossibilities
pitch: A ten-minute interactive story: unseal a cosmic museum's archive and decide what mercy means. Three endings.
controls: Tap a choice to continue; progress saves on the device.
